findings.summary: The supplied packet resolves the previously reported #49 media findings: OCR now requires a dedicated media.ocr AuthorizationRequest via authorize_and_reserve with provider/connection/upper_bound validation and fail-closed ocr_unavailable, attempt fencing through prepare_model_attempt before transport with abandon_before_transport on pre-transport failure, and a bounded retry fence that returns ModelAttemptAlreadyRecorded; extraction output is now validated through _validated_pages at both the subprocess and OCR boundaries with strict page shape, strict ascending numbering, per-page and total bounds; the download path requires a durable authenticated input row (request_ref) with owner tuple verification and exact file_ref/kind matching against the recorded media_input before any transport, with both reservations abandoned and no transport on mismatch. Live OCR substitution cannot occur without the dedicated scope; citations are restricted to validated actual page numbers and cited subset enforcement; one-use version-bound transcript revision uses expected_version and raises StateConflict on mismatch; accepted-but-accounting-unconfirmed results are preserved with retry_allowed=False and do not get reset. No remaining P0 or P1 concrete defects were found in the supplied code; remaining uncertainties concern unsupplied dependencies and adapter wiring, listed in not_verified.
